generalization.note: Outside this design space the surrogate is not used: the sizer only samples inside it, and every proposal is re-verified by the physics engine.

variables.elasticity_note: Median % change of the thermal resistance per +1% of each input (per +1 °C for ambient temperature). Negative = helps cooling.

training.optimizer: Adam (PINNeAPPle Trainer, best-val checkpoint) + L-BFGS polish

uncertainty.method: split conformal on log thermal resistance (calibration split)

90.reading: true resistance <= predicted x 1.017 for 90% of designs

95.reading: true resistance <= predicted x 1.020 for 95% of designs

uncertainty.use: The sizer screens with the 95% upper bound, then verifies with physics.

physics_checks.name: monotonic:power
physics_checks.law: In natural convection more power drives more buoyant flow, so the resistance falls as power rises.
physics_checks.detail: 100.0% of held-out designs have the physically required sign beyond the model's noise level; 100.0% with no tolerance at all (median effect -0.222).

physics_checks.name: monotonic:material conductivity
physics_checks.law: A more conductive material never raises the thermal resistance.
physics_checks.detail: 98.9% of held-out designs have the physically required sign beyond the model's noise level; 94.9% with no tolerance at all (median effect -0.026).

physics_checks.name: monotonic:source width / base width
